note: §13: D1 PREPARES an executable experimental protocol and runs NO stochastic calibration, NO Treatment trial and NO paid model call. Nothing here is an experimental result.

targetEstimand.estimand: the INCREMENTAL effect of source-qualified Trajectory evidence beyond existing Context
targetEstimand.control: Existing Canonical Work Context + Existing PriorResultContext
targetEstimand.treatment: the SAME Context + a source-qualified Trajectory Capsule delivered through the attempt-bound Context boundary

deliveryPrecondition.mechanism: the C6 experimental Attempt-bound delivery (install option experimentalTrajectoryContextDelivery, DEFAULT OFF), which materializes the qualified Capsule into compiled.trajectoryCapsule before the first model turn
deliveryPrecondition.requirement: a Treatment trial with failed delivery must NOT be interpreted as evidence that Trajectory has no utility
deliveryPrecondition.currentStatus: Capsule qualified / selected / materialized / delivered are proven by C4-C6 at the controlled and real-cold-recovery levels; Model Turn started and beyond are NOT run in this stage

candidateTaskFamilies.name: Governed Rework Continuation
candidateTaskFamilies.shape: an Origin Attempt has real execution history and an observed failure or incomplete result; the consumer Attempt is a legitimate governed continuation (a real A0 -> Rework -> A1 lineage)
measures: Correct identification of completed versus incomplete work

candidateTaskFamilies.name: Multi-Invocation Reconstruction
candidateTaskFamilies.shape: an Attempt has more than one execution Invocation with different qualification and coverage states (qualified, OBSERVATION_INCOMPLETE, CONFLICT)
candidateTaskFamilies.explicitNonFixture: a Session containing only startup configuration events is NOT an already-qualified Treatment for failure-avoidance utility

requirements: UQ-1 the baseline is neither at the floor nor at the ceiling, with room to move in BOTH directions
UQ-2 at least two outcome dimensions have variability under repetition of the control
UQ-3 at least one treatment-relevant failure class varies
UQ-4 the Capsule's own recorded method mechanically addresses an outcome that actually varies
UQ-5 success cannot hinge entirely on one unrelated residual case
benchmarkQualificationLaw.doNot: increase the Treatment trial count to compensate for an invalid fixture
benchmarkQualificationLaw.carriedForward: R2-VR showed Scenario D was saturated (every trial 13/14 or 14/14) and its remaining variance was one unrelated case (h14); D1 must not reuse Scenario C/D merely because they are easy to run

baselineOnlyCalibration.required: D1 begins with baseline-only calibration before ANY Treatment execution
baselineOnlyCalibration.method: run the control arm alone across the frozen dimensions and measure the per-dimension distribution
baselineOnlyCalibration.ifSaturated: BENCHMARK_NOT_QUALIFIED - NOT a reason to increase the number of Treatment trials
